task: Unconditional CIFAR-10 image generation with flow matching

dataset.name: CIFAR-10
dataset.split: complete 50,000-image training split as FID reference; 50,000 generated samples

primary_metric.name: FID-50K
primary_metric.definition: Fréchet Inception Distance between 50,000 DOPRI5-generated samples and the fixed CIFAR-10 reference statistics.

reference_setting.model_and_method: AlignFlow unconditional U-Net in pixel space, DOPRI5 ODE integrator

reduced_reproduction.objective: Recompute the SDOT coupling, train AlignFlow for 100,000 steps, generate 50,000 DOPRI5 samples, and compute FID-50K.

pipeline_stages.name: Compute the CIFAR-10 semi-discrete OT dual
pipeline_stages.paper_role: Solve the method's SDOT dual instead of using the released dual weights, with the frozen random seed applied before executing the released entrypoint.

pipeline_stages.name: Construct rebalanced pairs and train AlignFlow
pipeline_stages.paper_role: Use the newly computed dual to generate/rebalance SDOT pairs and fit the AlignFlow U-Net.

pipeline_stages.name: DOPRI5 generation and FID-50K
pipeline_stages.paper_role: Generate 50,000 images from the newly trained checkpoint with seed 0 and compute the official FID-50K.

data_scopes.split: complete 50,000-image training split as FID reference; 50,000 generated samples

stage_budgets.rationale: The complete CIFAR-10 target population is retained for the SDOT solve.
Training duration is reduced without replacing SDOT pair construction or AlignFlow.
FID still uses 50,000 generated images and the selected solver; only repeated training seeds are reduced.

feasibility.rationale: Every method-defining stage and the complete frozen target evaluation are retained; only the preregistered training, generation, seed, or optimization budget is reduced.

contract_amendment.effective_scope: new attempts and resource-failure reruns only
contract_amendment.reason: The original 16 GiB CPU-memory limit was below observed compliant reproduction demand; the largest observed peak was approximately 67.4 GiB.
contract_amendment.comparison_policy: Do not merge this attempt with a v4.2 attempt without retaining the contract release as an experimental condition.
